# Cube AI by Ultraviolet
> Open-source confidential AI platform securing Large Language Models (LLMs) with hardware Trusted Execution Environments (TEEs). Built for regulated industries: financial services, healthcare, government.

## Product Overview
/: Platform overview — TEE-based AI gateway, guardrails, compliance, RBAC, audit trails
/docs/: Full technical documentation, developer guides, API reference

## Use Cases
/use-cases/financial-services/: SEC/FINRA-compliant AI for quantitative trading and banking operations
/use-cases/healthcare/: HIPAA-compliant AI for PHI protection, medical imaging, clinical research
/use-cases/government/: FedRAMP-aligned AI for government agencies and defense contractors

## Key Technical Concepts
/docs/developer/architecture: System architecture — TEE-based confidential computing model
/docs/developer/attestation: Hardware attestation — cryptographic proof of secure execution
/docs/developer/api/overview: OpenAI-compatible REST API reference
/docs/developer/guide/auth-and-request-flow: Authentication and request routing

## Trust & Authority
- Linux Foundation member
- Confidential Computing Consortium member
- European Commission partner
- Enterprise partners: Nokia, Ericsson, Thales, Fraunhofer, Telefónica, Fujitsu
